justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/event/EventListenerSupport.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/event/EventListenerSupportTest.java. The class is ~360 lines with a small, cohesive API centered on one responsibility: manage a listener list, expose a fire() proxy, and handle serialization/proxy reconstitution. Its inner ProxyInvocationHandler and writeObject/readObject methods are support code for that same abstraction, not separate responsibilities, and the test file exercises exactly those behaviors (add/remove/getListeners/fire/serialization/subclassing), with no sign of multiple unrelated concerns or excessive method sprawl.
